text: 我会按只读离线范围核对原始报告、解析规则和 iperf 源码，重点判断 0–30 秒周期字节数能否作为独立吞吐量依据，并区分已完成与尚在进行的轮次。我会应用 `xts-board-evidence` 技能中的证据保全要求。
已确认第 1 轮 TCP TX 的 30 条周期记录完整，累计行确实多出 4,160 字节；UDP TX 的 30 秒后尾流和空闲周期也能明确剔除。当前第 2 轮已有完整记录，但 TCP RX 出现真实的连接重置提示，我正在核对它是否发生在板端 30 秒截止之后。
三轮 TX 均已完成，独立求和得到 TCP TX 约 3.145、3.071、2.262 Mbit/s，UDP TX 约 16.574、10.889、8.939 Mbit/s。源码明确区分固定周期时间与累计报告实际结束时间，因此把完整 0–30 秒周期单独报告是成立的；累计行不能仅凭显示为 “30.0” 就要求字节数完全相等。

**Yes: the independent 0–30 s periodic-byte derivation is sound for all three TCP TX rounds and UDP TX rounds.** Preserve the original collector classifications and add the derivation separately; no remeasurement is justified merely by cumulative-report rounding.

All twelve cases have finished. Independently verified all 24 stdout/stderr hashes against their round receipts; every case records `DONE ok=1`, `canceled=0`, idle `0/0`, complete capture and owned-host cleanup.

| Receiver measurement | Round 1 | Round 2 | Round 3 | Mean |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| TCP TX periodic bytes | 11,792,320 | 11,517,952 | 8,481,312 | — |
| TCP TX Mbit/s | 3.144619 | 3.071454 | 2.261683 | **2.825919** |
| UDP TX periodic bytes | 62,153,070 | 40,832,190 | 33,521,880 | — |
| UDP TX Mbit/s | 16.574152 | 10.888584 | 8.939168 | **12.133968** |

Each value uses exactly thirty contiguous, nonoverlapping one-second receiver periods: `sum(bytes) × 8 / 30 / 1,000,000`. Every selected period’s printed bit rate equals eight times its byte count.

The decisive source evidence is:

- Local associated host [Locale.c:632](/home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/host-udp-fin-timeline/source/baseline/src/Locale.c:632) prints CSV endpoints with **one decimal place**. [ReportOutputs.c:1182](/home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/host-udp-fin-timeline/source/baseline/src/ReportOutputs.c:1182) calculates integer bit rate from the **unrounded duration**.
- [Reporter.c:1043](/home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/host-udp-fin-timeline/source/baseline/src/Reporter.c:1043) distinguishes scheduled interval boundaries from actual cumulative end time. Its TCP finalization at line 1419 can suppress a short partial interval while retaining those bytes in the cumulative total.
- Consequently, [bench.py:304](/home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/tools/board-tests/korvo_idf_default_reference/bench.py:304) incorrectly treats equal **printed** endpoints as requiring exact cumulative/periodic byte equality.

TCP cumulative tails are **4,160 / 0 / 5,600 B**. Taking integer-rate truncation into account, cumulative durations are approximately **30.00147 / 30.00435 / 30.00735 s**. These cumulative values are internally plausible; they are simply a different interval. Exclude cumulative summaries consistently across all three rounds.

UDP has no final summary. Exclude the separately reported 30–31 s tails **45,570 / 39,690 / 38,220 B**, then the idle zero-byte intervals containing undefined loss percentages. The selected 0–30 s periods remain usable. Retain periodic loss/reordering as native diagnostics; neither final loss/ACK nor reliable jitter is established.

No measurement-window board socket error, starvation, reboot or cancellation was found. One substantive qualification remains: [round-02/tcp-rx/stderr.log:1](/home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-idf-default-baseline/network-30s-01/round-02/tcp-rx/stderr.log:1) contains a real connection-reset error. Its board completed thirty periods and stopped after **30.000345 s**; the host cumulative duration is approximately **30.039615 s**. Stock [iperf.c:632](/home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/diagnostics/idf-baseline/korvo-default-reference/components/iperf/iperf.c:632) closes the receiver socket at its timer cutoff. This supports a termination-boundary explanation, but untimestamped stderr cannot prove causation. Show its **2.85 Mbit/s** board report with that qualification and retain `incomplete_reference`; clean TCP RX results are **2.81 / 2.79 Mbit/s**, n=2. UDP RX prints **24.67 / 24.48 / 25.11 Mbit/s**, with the documented missing-ACK limitation.

Plan SHA-256 matches **`ec42c21222b71dd88593c972b3206ae3d8f231e14424bb86370d2ad976ff78f5`**; current `run.py`, `bench.py`, `host.py`, and `report.py` match its pins. Stock producer iperf sources match the published local originals. Host-source snapshot hashes match existing recorded source identities, although those records do not establish a fully reproducible source-to-original-EXE chain.

This supports a **descriptive 30-second reference**, not xTS acceptance or a hardware ceiling. No files were written and no hardware, Windows executable, network, build or test was run.
